reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named lab with the report for my exact batch is more than I get from most things on TikTok Shop. $24.99 for the first box is low enough to just try it.
objection: Two capsules every day is still a lot to swallow, and I only believe the lab report if the batch number really matches. I will not reorder at $29.99 unless there is a coupon.
